fullPassage: Heritability is frequently misunderstood. For example, it is not a constant like the speed of light or gravity. It is a statistic that describes a particular population at a particular time with that population's particular mix of genetic and environmental influences. A simpler way of expressing this is that it describes what is but does not predict what could be. Another population, or the same population at a different time, could have a different mix of genetic and environmental influences. Heritability will reflect these differences. For example, heritability of body weight is greater in wealthier countries such as the US than in poorer countries such as Albania and Nicaragua. Wealthier countries have greater access to fast-food outlets and high-energy snacks, and greater access to fattening food leads to higher heritability because it exposes genetic differences in people's propensities to put on the pounds.

det.korean: ② of express → of expressing: 전치사 of 뒤에는 동명사(expressing)가 와야 한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① frequently: 'is frequently misunderstood' — 동사(misunderstood)를 꾸미는 부사. 정상

✅ ② of express(오류): 'A simpler way of express this' — 전치사 of 뒤에는 명사/동명사가 와야 하므로 expressing. 동사원형 express는 전치사의 목적어가 될 수 없음 ← 정답

❌ ③ high-energy: 'high-energy snacks' — 명사를 꾸미는 복합형용사(하이픈 결합). 정상

❌ ④ to put: 'propensities to put on the pounds' — 명사 propensities를 뒤에서 꾸미는 to부정사. 정상
det.tip: 전치사(of/in/by 등) + 동명사(V-ing). of expressing(O) / of express(X).

✅ ① ← 정답: 유전율은 상수가 아니라(S2) 특정 집단·시점·환경의 조합을 기술하는 통계치(S3)로 조건이 달라지면 값도 달라진다(S5~S8). '불변의 상수로 오해하지 말라'가 핵심

det.tip: 글 전체 = 유전율은 변하는 통계치, 상수로 오해 말 것. ①만 이 논지를 담음.

questions.passage: Heritability is frequently misunderstood. For example, it is not a constant like the speed of light or gravity. It is a statistic that describes a particular population at a particular time with that population's particular mix of genetic and environmental influences. A simpler way of expressing this is that it describes what is but does not predict what could be. Another population, or the same population at a different time, could have a different mix of genetic and environmental influences. Heritability will reflect these differences. For example, heritability of body weight is greater in wealthier countries such as the US than in poorer countries such as Albania and Nicaragua. Wealthier countries have greater access to fast-food outlets and high-energy snacks, and greater access to fattening food leads to higher heritability because it exposes genetic differences in people's propensities to put on the pounds.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ② '유전율은 왜 집단과 환경에 따라 달라지는가' = 글의 핵심(변동성) / ① '유전율: 중력 같은 고정 상수' / ③ '체중을 줄이는 최고의 식단' / ④ '하나의 통계치로 미래 예측하기'
det.analysis:
❌ ① Heritability: A Fixed Constant Like Gravity(유전율: 중력 같은 고정 상수): 본문 S2는 유전율이 '상수가 아니다'라고 함. 정반대

✅ ② Why Heritability Changes with Population and Environment(유전율이 집단과 환경에 따라 달라지는 이유): 집단·시점·환경에 따라 달라지는 유전율의 본질(S3~S8)을 정확히 포괄 ← 정답

❌ ③ The Best Diet to Lower Your Body Weight(체중 감량 최고의 식단): 체중은 변동성의 예시일 뿐, 다이어트 안내가 아님

❌ ④ Predicting the Future from a Single Statistic(하나의 통계치로 미래 예측): 본문은 '예측하지 않는다(does not predict)'고 함. 왜곡
det.tip: 제목은 주제의 압축. 변동성(Changes with Population and Environment)을 담은 ②가 정답.

- a way of V-ing = ~하는 방법

- 목적어 what could be (무엇이 될 수 있는지) — 관계대명사 what + 조동사 could + be

조건 7단어(be, but, could, does, not, predict, what) = 정답 7단어와 일치.
det.tip: does not + 동사원형 = ~하지 않는다(단수 주어). what could be = 무엇이 될 수 있는지(가능성). describes what is와 대조.

- 전치사구: at a particular time (특정 시점에) — at + a + particular + time

'describes + 목적어(집단) + 시점(at a particular time)' 어순. (8단어)
det.tip: at a particular time = 특정 시점에. a particular + 명사 = 특정한 ~. 관사 a가 두 번, particular가 두 번 쓰임에 주의.
